title: cli: the stack-collection and docs readers return nothing for a non-array `packages` while refusing a malformed entry, which leaves the cli outside ruling #15293-A
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`, seat post #19357) from the out-of-scope findings of the #15293 dev (report `5801982470`; PR #19924). ⛔ Filed unassigned and unlabelled: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The rule this misses

Ruling A on #15293 (`5634034754`): a present `packages` that is not an array (`{}`, `0`, `'x'`) is malformed, not absent, and every reader refuses it. PR #19924 brings the runtime reader in line. The readers in `@objectstack/cli` were not in that ruling's designated file surface.

## The sites (read by this seat on `origin/main` `beac798026`)

- `packages/cli/src/utils/stack-collections.ts:99`, `packageBodies`: `if (!Array.isArray(declared) || declared.length === 0) return [];`
- `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts:386` (`docsPackageRefs`) and `:1054` (`bodyDocsOf`): `if (!Array.isArray(packages)) return [];`
- `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts:1253` (`attachPackageDocs`): `if (!Array.isArray(packages) || sets.length === 0) return packages;`

For `{}`, `0` and `'x'`, the dev measured `[]` or the same reference back. Lit controls: a well-formed entry gives `['a_acct']`, and an inlined entry refuses with `INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE_ENTRY`. ⚠️ This seat read the four guards but did not re-run the probe.

## Why it matters

The same artifact is refused by the runtime (after PR #19924), by `@objectstack/core`, and by the two plugin readers. The cli readers answer "no packages" for it instead. That is the split #15293 exists to close: readers must not disagree about what an artifact contains. The dev measured that nothing emits the shape today (`composeStacks` and `os build` / `os validate` refuse it first), so the cheap moment to align is now.

## Seam

`spec:ObjectStackDefinitionSchema.packages` → `cli:packages/cli/src/utils/stack-collections.ts packageBodies` | `cli:packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts`

Dedupe words: `resolveStackCollection non-array packages` · `packageBodies Array.isArray fall-through` · `docsPackageRefs packages not array` · `cli INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGES`
